title_candidates: OpenAI says Astra found ten new mathematics results
summary: OpenAI published ten AI-generated mathematics results with papers and Lean certificates. The useful lesson is how to separate a research claim from its supporting evidence.

primary_source.title: Ten advances in mathematics and theoretical computer science
primary_source.author: OpenAI
key_facts: OpenAI says an internal Astra model produced ten results across mathematics and theoretical computer science.
The company says the results resolve or substantially advance long-standing problems.
Humans prepared manuscripts with the model, which also formalized the arguments in Lean.
OpenAI estimates the successful solution tokens at roughly $2,000 at GPT-5.6 Sol API rates.

supporting_sources.title: openai/ten-proofs
key_facts: The repository publishes one or more Lean files for each listed result and instructions for independent proof checking.

supporting_sources.title: Ten advances in mathematics and theoretical computer science
key_facts: Simon Willison noted the public proofs and walkthroughs while pointing out that the prompts and unsuccessful attempts were not disclosed.

steps.instruction: Choose one result from OpenAI's article and copy only its short description.
Ask an assistant to separate prior knowledge, the new claim, significance, and uncertainty.
Remove unsupported additions by comparing the explanation with the source.
Find the corresponding Lean file in the public repository.
Record one supported fact and one question that still needs an expert.
